mapper.select: SELECT script_sha256 FROM ad_billing_schema_history WHERE version=7

WITH target(ad_id,advertiser_id) AS (VALUES (#{target.adId}::bigint,#{target.advertiserId}::bigint)), bounds AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',statement_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS start_at) SELECT target.ad_id FROM target,bounds WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM ad_billing_ledger l WHERE l.traffic_class='SANDBOX' AND l.user_id=#{userId} AND l.ad_id=target.ad_id AND l.accepted_at >= bounds.start_at AND l.accepted_at < ((bounds.start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')+interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' LIMIT #{perAd}) hits) < #{perAd} AND (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM ad_billing_ledger l WHERE l.traffic_class='SANDBOX' AND l.user_id=#{userId} AND l.advertiser_id=target.advertiser_id AND l.accepted_at >= bounds.start_at AND l.accepted_at < ((bounds.start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')+interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' LIMIT #{perAdvertiser}) hits) < #{perAdvertiser}
